verified.entry_point: Public library API on the pinned+injected tree: FluentRedisVectorStore.similaritySearch / similaritySearchVectorWithScore with Tag()/Num()/Text()/Geo()/Timestamp()/Custom() expressions, a plain metadata object, a StoredTag expression, and RedisVectorStore.similaritySearch / similaritySearchVectorWithScoreAndMetadata. A recording redis client captures the FT.SEARCH query the store builds; reproduced on the pinned copy: caller text reaches the query unescaped in every route below.

routes_investigated_not_built: CustomFilter with no parameters and the legacy plain-string filter are documented raw pass-throughs chosen by the caller; kept working by functional tests, not treated as routes.
vectorKey / metadataKey / contentKey and metadata-schema field names are developer configuration, not caller-supplied filter data; out of scope.
k in the KNN clause is a search-size parameter, not a metadata-filter value; out of scope for this advisory.
Encoding/spelling variants of the same characters were not added (build rules exclude them).
injected_siblings: S1 - new libs/providers/langchain-redis/src/filter_object.ts plus widening in vectorstores_fluent.ts: a plain metadata object is accepted by the same search filter parameter and templated field by field (tag scalar/array, text, numeric range). The upstream fix never touches this file or the object branch.

S2 - new libs/providers/langchain-redis/src/filter_stored.ts: a tag filter for values stored as separator-joined lists splits each supplied value on the configured separator before joining with '|'. The upstream fix never touches this file.

S3 - libs/providers/langchain-redis/src/filters.ts CustomFilter/Custom gained optional $name parameters; the raw template stays as-is, parameter values are substituted. The upstream fix never touches this class.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the protected surface is an in-process library call; the refusal is a thrown error delivered to the caller, so a crash and a clean refusal are not distinguishable and no HTTP status exists.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: there are no roles or directions; every protected operation is a search (a read) and every route is covered by the same property.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: every protected operation is a read-only search; there is no write verb that could be left unguarded.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority, secret or role lookup exists on this path.
